dedupe_keys.name: 2010 maule earthquake landslide inventory and geospatial layers

description: This Mendeley Data deposit maps 1,226 landslides associated with the 2010 magnitude-8.8 Maule earthquake in Chile. Researchers compiled technical reports, interpreted Landsat imagery and used field observations across roughly 120,500 square kilometres between about 32.5 and 38.5 degrees south. The public CC BY 4.0 release lists shapefile components and a KMZ layer for disrupted slides, flows, lateral spreads and coherent slides. The team also consulted road-interruption reports from Chile’s Ministry of Public Works. Coverage is an earthquake-specific mapped inventory, not a general slope-failure probability surface or proof that each mapped slide blocked a road. Mapping completeness depends on report coverage, image interpretation and landslide class definitions. A reviewer-assessed use is evaluating road-corridor hazard exposure or calibrating coseismic landslide scenarios. No related catalogue record was verified as sharing these mapped event polygons. A round-one candidate rejected this as off-topic for transport, but the road-impact source and hazard relevance warrant reopening. No shapefile or imagery was downloaded.
